prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your specific needs (hospital system vs. private practice vs. medical device vs. clinical trial), budget, timeline and the mix of services you need (branding, digital acquisition, physician outreach, PR, patient experience, etc.). I can point you to how to find the best fit and help shortlist agencies once I know more about your priorities.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies:
- What type of healthcare organization are you (hospital, clinic, specialty practice, med device, pharma, health tech)?
- Primary goals (new patient acquisition, brand awareness, physician referrals, employer partnerships, product launches)?
- Annual marketing budget or monthly spend range?
- Do you need local-only services or nationwide campaigns?
- Any must-have services (SEO, PPC, content, video, PR, CRM integration, HIPAA-compliant messaging)?

How to find the best agency (practical steps)
1. Search portals and reviews: Clutch, UpCity, G2, Google Business Profiles and LinkedIn for top-rated local agencies with healthcare case studies.
2. Check industry awards and memberships: look for healthcare marketing awards (e.g., HCEA, HSMAI), and agency experience with healthcare associations.
3. Evaluate portfolio & case studies: look for measurable outcomes (CPL, conversion rate, patient volume lift), not just creative samples.
4. Verify compliance expertise: HIPAA, PHI handling, telehealth marketing rules, pharma/CMS restrictions if applicable.
5. Ask for references: ideally current/past clients similar to your organization; ask about reporting cadence, responsiveness and results.
6. Request an RFP or trial project: a paid pilot or short-term engagement can prove fit before a large commitment.

Key criteria to compare agencies
- Healthcare-specific expertise and regulatory knowledge
- Measurable results and analytics capabilities (ROAS, cost per acquisition)
- Integrated approach (digital + offline + PR if needed)
- Creative and content capabilities (patient/physician storytelling)
- Technology integrations (EHR/CRM, marketing automation)
- Transparent pricing and reporting cadence
- Responsiveness and cultural fit with your team

Sample interview questions to ask agencies
- Can you show case studies for clients like us and the specific KPIs you achieved?
- How do you handle PHI and HIPAA concerns in marketing campaigns?
- What channels have driven the best patient acquisition for similar clients?
- What is your reporting cadence and what metrics do you include?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact and what is the escalation process?
- Can you provide three client references we can call?

Suggested KPIs to require
- New patients/acquisitions (and cost per acquisition)
- Website conversions (appointment requests, form fills)
- Organic search rankings and traffic growth
- Paid campaign metrics: CTR, conversion rate, CPL
- Reputation metrics: reviews, average rating, response time

Red flags
- No healthcare case studies or no measurable results
- Vague answers on HIPAA/PHI handling
- Promises of “guaranteed #1 rankings”
- No clear reporting schedule or opaque pricing

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a shortlist of St. Louis agencies tailored to your answers above
- Draft an RFP or outreach email to send to agencies
- Provide a 30/60/90-day evaluation plan for a new agency engagement

Tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll give a targeted shortlist or draft an RFP/email for outreach.
